scenes.title: 怪物就像洋葱
quotes: No! Layers! Onions have layers. Ogres have layers. Onions have layers.
不！层次！洋葱有层次，怪物也有层次。
You get it? We both have layers.
你明白了吗？我们都有层次。

scenes.title: 吼一声嘛！
quotes: Excuse me, Mr. Shrek. Could you do that ogre roar of yours for my son? He's a big, big fan.
打扰了，史莱克先生。可以为我儿子表演一下怪物吼叫吗？他是你的超级粉丝。
You know, I'd rather not. It's my kids' birthday party.
我还是不想。这是我孩子们的生日聚会。
Honey, why don't you go check on the cake?
亲爱的，你去看看蛋糕好吗？
Sure. And don't forget the candles.

scenes.title: 谁让你们来这里的？
quotes: Oh, gosh, no one invited us.
We were forced to come here.
He huffed and he puffed and he—
他呼哧呼哧地吹气，然后他——

scenes.title: 你认识松饼人吗？
scenes.english: Do you know the Muffin Man?
quotes: Okay, I'll tell you. Do you know the Muffin Man?
好吧，我告诉你。你认识松饼人吗？
Yes, I know the Muffin Man. Who lives on Drury Lane?
我认识松饼人。住在德鲁里巷的那个？
Well, she's married to the Muffin Man.
She's married to the Muffin Man.
